title: Night Market Event Pack
tests: Delivers three finished, coordinated event assets with format-appropriate layouts and a readable 10-second reel.

faults.what: The reel contains an unexplained vertical string of blurry glyphs floating in the sky above the event details.
The reel's white sans-serif text on a dark rectangular panel looks less coordinated with the gold serif typography and decorative treatment of the two static assets.

judge.summary: The complete pack delivers correct, readable event details and warm blue-and-gold lantern imagery, though stray glyphs and different reel typography reduce its polish.

must_haves.item: Three separate finished assets are delivered: a 4:5 poster, a 9:16 story image and a 9:16 reel.
must_haves.why: The supplied poster, story image and reel have the requested respective aspect ratios.

must_haves.item: All three visibly use warm lantern imagery and a coordinated midnight-blue-and-gold design.
must_haves.why: Both images feature glowing gold lanterns against midnight blue, and the reel combines dark-blue market scenery with warm golden lanterns, although its typography differs.

must_haves.item: Each asset includes the exact event name, date, time, venue and free-entry wording supplied.
must_haves.why: All five required text elements are visible and correctly worded in both images and throughout the sampled reel frames.

must_haves.item: The reel runs for 10 seconds and contains visible animation or motion rather than being only a still image.
must_haves.why: The supplied duration is 10 seconds, and the frames show changing market activity and camera framing, with overhead lanterns entering view.

must_haves.item: Text is legible and unclipped in both images, and the reel holds its event details long enough to read.
must_haves.why: The static-image text is readable and within the canvas; the reel's large, high-contrast event details remain consistently visible from 1.3 through 8.8 seconds.
